summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) Dex reorder, (2) animated idle sprites, and (3) combat integrity + matchups/shiny regression. All six requested scenarios pass. (A) scripts/validate_reorder.py reports ALL VALIDATION PASSED — 150 creatures, ids 10001..10150 unchanged, displayOrder a complete 1..150 permutation, evolvesFrom/To mutually consistent, every family contiguous & base-first in displayOrder, legendaries/mythicals at 140..150, type totals unchanged. (B) Live Original roster renders in new order: pos#1 #001 Mossplod(WATER) -> pos#2 #002 Mosshull(WATER) -> pos#3 #003 Bathyward(WATER/STEEL) family contiguous and base-first; first 30 cards cover 14 unique types (grass/dark/fighting/flying/bug/dragon/steel/water/fire/poison/rock/psychic/ground/normal) — NOT all one type. (C) Pokemon roster order UNCHANGED — #001 Bulbasaur, #002 Ivysaur, #003 Venusaur, #004 Charmander, #005 Charmeleon, #006 Charizard, #007 Squirtle, #008 Wartortle (National Dex). (D) Search by new dex number '3' matches Bathyward (displayOrder=3). (E) Creature detail sheet for #001 Mossplod opens (testid creature-detail-popover) and renders the full Type Matchups panel (matchup-weak2, matchup-resist2, matchup-neutral, matchup-stab, matchup-moves all present). (F) Started a 6v6 quick battle from the Original roster (team ids 10001,10068,10090,10110,10019,10102 picked via taps; start-battle-button enabled; navigated to /battle). Player Mossplod visibly idle-animates (aqua sway + particles) in the live canvas, opponent Tadmuck renders and attacks. HP progressed monotonically over ~36s sampling: 111 -> 106 -> 99 -> 91 -> 80 -> 71 -> 64 (15 unique HP snapshots across 20 reads) — continuous deterministic progression, no stall, no duplicate damage events, no visual crash, no pageerror / console errors. Battle was still progressing at the end of the observation window — not a bug, just a long match; damage is accruing correctly. Shiny roster counter (roster-shiny-count) code-path intact (RosterPage.jsx shinyCount useMemo unchanged, renders when >0).
critical_code_review_comments: lib/format.js displayNo() correctly falls back to dexNo/id when displayOrder is absent — safe for the Pokemon roster where displayOrder is not set, so Pokemon cards still show their National Dex number (confirmed live).

RosterPage filter now matches both the new displayOrder and legacy dexNo for numeric search (`String(c.displayOrder ?? c.dexNo ?? '') === q.replace(/^#0*/, '')`) — correct behavior; searching '3' finds Bathyward.

renderer.js idleOffsets() is wall-clock (now / 1000) and view-only — it is called inside drawUnit but does NOT feed back into the fixed-tick engine. The engine advances via state.tick (see uses of state.tick, releaseTick, lastCastTick), and damage/events are drained from state.events (consumeEvents dedup'd by this.lastEventId). Confirmed live: HP decreased monotonically with no doubled damage numbers.

idle animation is correctly gated: only applied when `Math.hypot(u.vel.x, u.vel.y) < 0.1 && u.state === 'active' && !reducedMotion`, so it never fires during movement, casting, recovery, faint, or switch — no interference with the existing attack/hit/faint reactions.

motionProfile is memoized per creatureId via MOTION_CACHE — a Map that persists across renders. This is fine for the current single-battle session, but note it's module-level: profiles accumulate if many distinct creatures are seen across sessions (not a defect, just an observation; 150 Original + 493 Pokemon worst case is negligible).
CreatureCard renders dexNo(displayNo(creature)) for Original creatures (displayOrder ∈ 1..150) and for Pokemon (dexNo) — no divergence; visible #s match spec.
Minor: the review request mentions a `creature-details-{id}` testid; the actual detail-sheet testid is `creature-detail-popover`. Not a defect — already flagged in iteration_12.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dex reorder is baked into creatures.json (field `displayOrder`) and validate_reorder.py can be re-run after any content edit (`python /app/scripts/validate_reorder.py`). The Original-roster team-selection tap works reliably via mouse.down()/up() with ~80ms down-duration (<450ms long-press threshold) + 250ms settle; verifying data-selected='true' on the card after each tap is the reliable gate. Battle page is /battle (not /battle/{id}). End-of-battle banner testid wasn't observed because the match ran longer than the sampling window — not a defect; the deterministic engine was clearly advancing (HP 111 -> 64 over ~36s, 15 unique snapshots). creature-detail-popover is the sheet testid; matchup-* testids are: matchup-weak2/weak4/resist2/resist4/immune/neutral/stab/moves.
